projects.name: CineVerse
projects.tagline: Anime & K-drama streaming platform with AI assistant
projects.description: Mobile streaming app with offline playback and community features
projects.overview: CineVerse is a mobile streaming platform designed for anime and K-drama enthusiasts. It combines content streaming with AI-powered recommendations, offline playback, and community engagement features.
projects.problem: Users struggle with fragmented streaming services, lack of offline viewing, and difficulty discovering content that matches their preferences.
projects.solution: Built a unified platform with Google Drive integration for content delivery, AI assistant for personalized recommendations, and robust offline playback system.
projects.outcome: Created a feature-rich streaming experience with seamless offline support and intelligent content discovery.

features.title: Offline Playback
features.description: Download and watch content without internet connection

features.title: AI Assistant
features.description: Gemini-powered chatbot for recommendations and queries

features.title: Community Features
features.description: User profiles, watchlists, and social interactions

features.title: Google Drive Integration
features.description: Efficient content delivery and storage management

architecture.structure: Flutter app with Firebase backend, modular architecture separating UI, business logic, and data layers
architecture.dataHandling: Firebase Firestore for metadata, Google Drive API for content streaming, local SQLite for offline data
architecture.scalability: Cloud-based content delivery, efficient caching strategies, lazy loading for large content libraries
architecture.performance: Optimized video streaming with adaptive quality, background downloads, memory-efficient image loading

challenges.challenge: Managing large video files and offline storage
challenges.solution: Implemented chunked downloads with resume capability and storage optimization
challenges.learning: Learned efficient file management and background task handling in Flutter

challenges.challenge: Integrating AI assistant without impacting app performance
challenges.solution: Used async API calls with loading states and response caching
challenges.learning: Understood API integration patterns and state management for AI features

projects.name: DevStudio
projects.tagline: Developer learning platform with AI workflows
projects.description: Platform for developers to learn with AI-assisted tools
projects.overview: DevStudio is a comprehensive learning platform designed for developers. It combines educational content with AI-powered workflows and community-driven resources.
projects.problem: Developers need a centralized platform that combines learning resources with practical AI tools and community support.
projects.solution: Building an integrated platform with curated learning paths, AI-assisted coding tools, and collaborative features.
projects.outcome: Currently in active development with core features being implemented.

features.title: Learning Paths
features.description: Structured courses and tutorials for various technologies

features.title: AI Workflows
features.description: AI-powered tools to assist in coding and problem-solving

features.title: Community Resources
features.description: Shared projects, code snippets, and discussions

architecture.structure: Flutter web application with modular feature-based architecture
architecture.dataHandling: Firebase for user data and content, real-time sync for collaborative features
architecture.scalability: Microservices approach for AI tools, CDN for static content delivery
architecture.performance: Code splitting, lazy loading, optimized asset delivery

challenges.challenge: Balancing feature richness with performance on web
challenges.solution: Implementing progressive loading and feature flags
challenges.learning: Understanding web-specific optimization techniques in Flutter

projects.name: Portfolio OS
projects.tagline: OS-style interactive portfolio with desktop environment
projects.description: Web application simulating a desktop operating system
projects.overview: Portfolio OS is an interactive web portfolio designed as a desktop operating system. It showcases projects, skills, and experience through a familiar desktop interface.
projects.problem: Traditional portfolios lack interactivity and fail to demonstrate frontend development skills effectively.
projects.solution: Created a fully functional OS simulation with draggable windows, working apps, and system-level interactions.
projects.outcome: Built a unique portfolio that demonstrates React expertise and creative problem-solving.

features.title: Multiple Apps
features.description: Terminal, Browser, VS Code, Database Manager, and more

features.title: System Tray
features.description: Control center with real browser APIs (battery, brightness)

features.title: Desktop Icons
features.description: Clickable app launchers with OS-native styling

architecture.structure: React with context-based state management, component-driven architecture
architecture.dataHandling: Local state for window management, localStorage for user preferences
architecture.scalability: Modular app system allowing easy addition of new applications
architecture.performance: Optimized re-renders, lazy loading for app components, CSS-based animations

challenges.challenge: Managing complex window state and z-index ordering
challenges.solution: Implemented centralized window manager with focus tracking
challenges.learning: Mastered React context and complex state management patterns

challenges.challenge: Creating smooth drag-and-drop without performance issues
challenges.solution: Used react-draggable with optimized event handlers
challenges.learning: Understood performance optimization for interactive UIs

projects.name: MentorHub
projects.description: Comprehensive management system for educational institutions
projects.overview: MentorHub is a complete school and college management system with role-based access for students, teachers, and administrators. Currently being rebuilt with Flutter for better performance and user experience.
projects.problem: Educational institutions need a unified system for attendance, grades, communication, and administrative tasks.
projects.solution: Building a multi-role platform with dedicated interfaces for each user type and real-time data synchronization.
projects.outcome: Legacy web version exists; rebuilding with modern architecture and mobile-first approach.

features.title: Multi-Role Access
features.description: Separate interfaces for students, teachers, and admins

features.title: Grade Management
features.description: Assignment submission, grading, and progress tracking

architecture.structure: Flutter app with clean architecture, separating presentation, domain, and data layers
architecture.dataHandling: Firebase for real-time data, MongoDB for complex queries, local caching for offline support
architecture.scalability: Role-based data access, efficient query patterns, pagination for large datasets
architecture.performance: Optimized list rendering, background sync, efficient state management

challenges.challenge: Managing complex role-based permissions and data access
challenges.solution: Implementing robust authentication and authorization layer
challenges.learning: Understanding security patterns and role-based access control

challenges.challenge: Migrating from legacy web system to modern architecture
challenges.solution: Incremental migration with parallel systems during transition
challenges.learning: Learned system migration strategies and backward compatibility
